remarks: Welcome to this charming Multi-Family home, ideal for investors or multi-generational living. The first floor unit features a spacious living room that flows into a bright dining area, perfect for gatherings. The well-equipped kitchen is complimented by two comfortable bedrooms and a full bathroom. On the second floor, enjoy a similarly inviting layout, with a cozy living room and functional kitchen. This unit also includes two bedrooms, a full bathroom, and an extra office space that can serve as a den or playroom- great for remote work of family activities. Both units have private decks, creating lovely outdoor spaces to unwind. The backyard features a welcoming patio, ideal for entertaining. An attached garage adds convenience and storage options. Additionally the home boasts full finished basement, providing extra space for recreation. With its versatile layout and prime location, this property presents a fantastic opportunity for both living and investment.
